scope: Original single seven-type Nodes.Filter and low->mid->high Nodes.EQ2, including default/property/scheduled histories, Float32 detune division and unchanged pinned Biquad coefficients/state. Captured Native insertion frames; fixed logical mono/stereo, declared pull. No synchronous AudioParam getters, external LFO, automatic tail/layout or normal Instrument selection claim.

normalization.formula: double frequency/nyquist; multiply by exp2(float(detune/1200)) when detune!=0
normalization.fork: Identical accepted Biquad helper except explicit pre-normalized frequency input avoids multiply/divide refitting.
